description: The 27 Legendary Nikes - special fragments of OG Nike carrying more of his essence. More power, more burden, more vulnerable to corruption.
expansionNote: The Shattering created 5,555 fragments. We know of 27 Legendaries. More may exist undiscovered in dimensions we haven't reached.

categories.champions: Combat specialists. Warriors who fight on the front lines.
categories.scholars: Knowledge keepers. The ones who solve problems.
categories.beasts: More creature than pig. Primal power.
categories.cosmic: Connected to the fabric of existence itself.

legendaryNikes.name: Gladiator Nike
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Contract - fighting is all he knows
legendaryNikes.corruptionEra: The Corruption Wars (500-1000 years after Prime Era)
legendaryNikes.quote: AT LAST. WORTHY OPPONENTS.

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Guards the Imperial Colosseum as its corrupted champion. His identity has collapsed entirely into combat—fighting is all he knows, all he remembers. Colosseum Charles trained him, watched him fall. Defeating him unlocks the underground bunker where Nike Prime was born.
gameEncounter.quote_game: AT LAST. WORTHY OPPONENTS.

legendaryNikes.name: Ninja Nike
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Contract - saw futures without hope
legendaryNikes.corruptionEra: Fifteen years ago — NOT The Forgetting. He made a deal to protect his people from a Retnuhxed Apex that came through a rift in the Shadow Temple, taking corruption to save them from something worse. The shipped Shinden arc depends on this being recent: his clan still remembers him.
legendaryNikes.quote: I thought I saw Shiro leave through a portal. I convinced myself I was dreaming.

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Trapped in endless prophecy-visions within the Shinden mist. The purple mist covering the realm for fifteen years is his psychic scream. His best student Yuki fought the corruption for three years before breaking. Freeing him clears the mist and reveals three more Legendaries hidden beneath it.
gameEncounter.quote_game: The mist... is me. My scream made visible.

legendaryNikes.name: Viking Nike
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Addiction - needed battle to feel alive
legendaryNikes.corruptionEra: The Forgetting (300-500 years after Prime Era)
legendaryNikes.quote: I've killed everything worth killing. What's left?

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Sits on an empty throne in the endless winter. The winter itself is Nolem's punishment for Frostfall producing one of his strongest foes. Erik, once like a son to Frostfall's elder Bjorn, was corrupted trying to negotiate for his people's safety. Putting Viking Nike down begins the thaw that awakens three more entombed Legendaries — either resolution counts, freed or not.
gameEncounter.quote_game: I've killed everything worth killing. What's left?

legendaryNikes.name: Nike Tyson Nike
legendaryNikes.description: Float like a butterfly, sting like a Nike
legendaryNikes.primeEraRole: Champion - 'Boxer Nike' in Comic Book 1. Striker/Morale.
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Boredom - no worthy opponents left
legendaryNikes.corruptionEra: The Corruption Wars (500-1000 years after Prime Era)
legendaryNikes.quote: EVERYONE'S GOT A PLAN TILL THEY GET PUNCHED IN THE FACE.
legendaryNikes.note: Name evolved from 'Boxer Nike' to 'Nike Tyson' over millennia as legend became myth.

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Known as the Knockout King. His world devolved from honorable combat to brutal spectacle. Slate, the burned-out Collector who lost six partners, guards his path. After millennia, 'Boxer Nike' became 'Nike Tyson'—legend becoming myth. Freeing him unlocks the Arena's deeper levels where Berjador and Peter Porker are trapped.
gameEncounter.quote_game: EVERYONE'S GOT A PLAN TILL THEY GET PUNCHED IN THE FACE.

legendaryNikes.name: Cyberpunk Nike
legendaryNikes.description: Neon-lit street warrior of the future
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Ideology - believed Nolem's way was better
legendaryNikes.corruptionEra: The Corruption Wars (500-1000 years after Prime Era)
legendaryNikes.quote: The system is broken. I'm just accelerating the inevitable.

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Corrupted by ideology—believed Nolem's way of revolution was better than reform. Echo, the Harbinger who uploaded their consciousness to escape pain, serves as his enforcer. Freeing Cyberpunk Nike unlocks the Deep Network where three more Legendaries exist as corrupted programs.
gameEncounter.quote_game: The system is broken. I'm just accelerating the inevitable.

legendaryNikes.name: Berjador Nike
legendaryNikes.description: Godzilla-like kaiju charged with infinite power
legendaryNikes.primeEraRole: Held a dimensional breach for seven days while others escaped
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: Couldn't leave his post - the breach would have consumed everything
legendaryNikes.corruptionTheme: The warrior who can't stop fighting
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Exhaustion - forgot what he was fighting FOR
legendaryNikes.corruptionEra: The First Falls (50-100 years after Prime Era)
legendaryNikes.quote: I... CAN'T... STOP...

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Found in the Dragon's Pit beneath the Grand Arena, pacing endlessly with white-hot scales. Has been fighting shadows for centuries, unable to stop. His Infinite Charge builds with every blow—each strike powering up the next. The warrior who can't stop fighting, trapped in an endless loop of combat.
gameEncounter.quote_game: FIGHT ME! FIGHT ME OR I'LL FIGHT MYSELF!

legendaryNikes.name: Bertus Maximus Nike
legendaryNikes.primeEraRole: Fighting his own war in another dimension
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: Unreachable - deep in enemy territory
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Fulfillment - found endless war with Nolem
legendaryNikes.corruptionEra: The First Falls (50-100 years after Prime Era)
legendaryNikes.quote: IS THAT ALL YOU'VE GOT?!

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Frozen mid-hunt and waking with the thaw to continue exactly where he stopped. The Beast King—a lion-formed Nike of impossible size, mane crackling with frost and fire—came to Frostfall seeking a worthy opponent, found only prey, and took Nolem's offer of endless war. You intercept him at the village edge. Three centuries on the ice: no jarl, no pack, no hall to come home to.
gameEncounter.quote_game: Nolem promised me endless war. Endless prey. He never promised me a hall to come home to.

legendaryNikes.name: Dr Caleb Nike
legendaryNikes.primeEraRole: Critical research - sent data instead of coming in person
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: Research too important to pause
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Curiosity - wanted to understand Nolem from inside
legendaryNikes.corruptionEra: The Scholar Legacy (100-300 years after Prime Era)
legendaryNikes.quote: To truly understand something, you must become it.

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Found in the medical wing of the underground bunker beneath the Colosseum, still running experiments after millennia. His corruption manifests as obsessive curiosity—cultivating corruption in himself to study it. His 'demonstrations' reveal the corruption he's been nurturing. One of five Scholars who together reveal the truth of Nike Prime's missing empathy core.
gameEncounter.quote_game: The empathy core... it was never installed. They ran out of time.

legendaryNikes.name: Professor Nike
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: Focused on preservation, not combat
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Unknown

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Found in the Endless Archives—shelves of data crystals, scrolls, and holographic texts stretching impossibly far. Still reading, still cataloging, unable to stop. Wields information itself as a weapon—painful truths, buried secrets, forgotten failures. Confirms Nike Prime was 99% complete when released.
gameEncounter.quote_game: Nike Prime was 99% complete. Powerful enough to trap Nolem. But unable to BOND.

legendaryNikes.name: Satoshi Nike
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: Systems were too important to abandon
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Regret - his systems weren't enough to save anyone
legendaryNikes.quote: I built something meant to last forever. Nothing lasts forever.

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Found in the Systems Core—the bunker's heart of humming servers and crystalline computing arrays. Maintains the systems that once connected all dimensions, refusing to let them die. His perfect systems turn against intruders—automated defenses activating, data streams weaponized. Reveals the empathy core required 5,555 bonds.
gameEncounter.quote_game: The design called for the empathy core to be powered by collective bonds. 5,555 bonds, to be precise.

legendaryNikes.name: Corey Hort Nike
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: Too deep in research to be reached
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Unknown

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Found in the Aeth'kai Vault—the deepest chamber holding the oldest secrets. Texts written in languages predating the multiverse. Eyes that have seen too much. Attacks not to hurt but to share his burden—to make you UNDERSTAND what he's seen. Connects the Aeth'kai prophecy to the 5,555 number.
gameEncounter.quote_game: The Aeth'kai prophecy. 'When 5,555 souls carry each other, the trap may open.'

legendaryNikes.name: Guthix Nike
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: His music was holding dimensions stable
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Unknown

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Found in the Harmony Chamber—crystalline structures singing with dimensional frequencies. Maintains a perfect balance that's slowly killing him. Disturbing his concentration shatters the balance; he attacks reflexively, desperately trying to restore harmony through force. The last Scholar freed before the Truth of Nike Prime is revealed.
gameEncounter.quote_game: Balance is not stillness. Balance is a thousand forces in perfect tension.

legendaryNikes.name: Nel Nike
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: Too unstable - might have turned mid-battle
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Self-hatred - believed she deserved corruption
legendaryNikes.corruptionEra: The Forgetting (300-500 years after Prime Era)
legendaryNikes.quote: I was always going to end up here. At least now I've stopped pretending.

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: The self-cursing witch of Shinden. Found in a clearing of twisted trees with a bubbling cauldron and faded talismans. Every curse she cast on others, she cast on herself first. Invited her own corruption. Her voice echoes like wind through dead leaves. The curse she placed recognizes those who knew her before—even Ronin Charles cannot approach safely. Centuries of self-inflicted pain made manifest.
gameEncounter.quote_game: I don't WANT to be saved. Because I deserve this.

legendaryNikes.name: Pigsterio Nike
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: His magic might have destroyed allies too
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Guilt - used his power once and destroyed something precious
legendaryNikes.quote: I told them my power was too dangerous. They should have listened.

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: The arcane master hidden deepest in Neon City's network, watching everything. Doesn't want to be found. His power is too dangerous—arcane energy that twists reality itself. Attacks to drive you away, to keep you safe from what he might accidentally do. Power used responsibly means not using it at all, in his mind.
gameEncounter.quote_game: You should not have come here. Not for my sake. For YOURS.

legendaryNikes.name: Jedi Nike
legendaryNikes.description: Master of the Force across dimensions
legendaryNikes.primeEraRole: Guarding a different sector of the multiverse
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: His sector needed him more
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Unknown

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Found in an ancient temple in the mountain peaks, now visible without the mist. Suspended in eternal meditation with dark energy crackling around his form. The temple hums with energy—not magic but discipline given form. An eternally meditating monk whose Force connection has been corrupted, turning contemplation into imprisonment.
gameEncounter.quote_game: I sought peace. I found... this.

legendaryNikes.name: Hydra Nike
legendaryNikes.primeEraRole: Multiple minds couldn't agree to join
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: Internal conflict - the three heads argued endlessly
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Internal conflict - Nolem offered peace between the heads
legendaryNikes.quote: For the first time, we agree on something. Silence.

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Three arguing heads breach the frozen sea as the thaw spreads. One wants destruction, one urges caution, one just wants to go back to sleep. They were not always three: one Nike, then a dimensional collision, and suddenly three minds in one body. Charles helped them find balance, and for a while the Hydra was the Convergence's greatest success story — proof that even the broken could be made whole. Then Nolem found the fracture and corrupted only the weakest head, the one that whispered 'why do we have to share?'. That head corrupted the others. Now all three are twisted, each blaming the others, each trying to take control, and every time you cut one down the others grow stronger.
gameEncounter.quote_game: FINALLY FREE! I say we DESTROY everything! / Wait. We should assess— / I just want to go back to sleep.

legendaryNikes.name: Wolf Mode Nike
legendaryNikes.primeEraRole: Lost to his curse - too dangerous to approach
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: Couldn't tell friend from foe
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Curse - the wolf was always there, Nolem just let it out
legendaryNikes.quote: The wolf doesn't serve Nolem. The wolf serves no one. That's the point.

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Massive tracks lead into the newly visible forest after the mist clears. A hunter in the darkness—fur matted with shadow-stuff, eyes burning with primal hunger. But beneath the beast is a pig trying to remember what he was. His den is littered with bones and torn fabric. Living with what the curse made him.
gameEncounter.quote_game: The beast... IS me now. I stopped fighting it long ago.

legendaryNikes.name: Colossal Nike
legendaryNikes.primeEraRole: Collateral damage too high to deploy
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: Would have destroyed the Colosseum just by arriving
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Guilt - accidentally destroyed a dimension trying to save it
legendaryNikes.quote: I tried to help. I always try to help. Everything I touch breaks.

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: What appeared to be a snow-covered mountain peak is actually Colossal Nike—a titan frozen mid-stride, now awakening as Frostfall thaws. Avalanches cascade as he stirs. Froze himself from guilt over a dimension he accidentally destroyed. His grief erupts into rage; each wild swing causes earthquakes. You climb his massive form to reach his head—to reach the NIKE inside the monster.
gameEncounter.quote_game: I TRIED TO HELP. I ALWAYS TRY. EVERYTHING I TOUCH... BREAKS.

legendaryNikes.name: Elbonzys Nike
legendaryNikes.description: Charizard-like dragon master, born from flame
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: Refused to leave his domain
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: NOT CORRUPTED — never fell. His bond is to the door itself; he is a test to be passed, not a corruption to be broken.

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: A dragon of the void, ancient beyond measure, standing before the gate to Nolem's Maw. Not corrupted—just patient and devoted to a single purpose: letting no one pass without proving worthy. Scales shimmer with the light of dead stars. This is not corruption to be broken but a test to be passed. OG Nike says he never managed to earn Elbonzys's respect. The uncorrupted gatekeeper.
gameEncounter.quote_game: I am not your enemy. I am your test.

legendaryNikes.name: Cardano Whale Nike
legendaryNikes.description: Majestic whale blessed by crypto currents
legendaryNikes.primeEraRole: Deep in dimensional currents - couldn't be reached
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: No way to communicate with him
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Grief - lost his pod, his family, in the depths
legendaryNikes.quote: The currents showed me what I lost. Nolem showed me how to forget.

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Rises from the dimensional currents between realities, massive beyond comprehension. He has been searching the void for his pod — his family — endlessly, desperately, and he can no longer remember their names. His form blocks out the void itself. The madness of searching for something you'll never find. Grief that became an ocean. (The raid layer frames the same wound wider: 'Then Nolem devoured his ocean.')
gameEncounter.quote_game: I searched for so long... and I was searching for them. My pod. My family. And I can't even remember...

legendaryNikes.name: Cosmic Nike
legendaryNikes.description: Born from stardust and reality itself
legendaryNikes.primeEraRole: Drifting between realities - couldn't be located
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: Exists partially outside normal space
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Nihilism - saw the heat death of the universe and gave up
legendaryNikes.quote: Everything ends. Everything. Why delay the inevitable?

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Found where reality grows thin and stars seem close enough to touch. A figure made of stardust and void, born from cosmic dust and entropy. Stars are born and die within him in seconds. His corruption is nihilism—the conviction that everything ends, so nothing matters. Expands into a miniature galaxy during battle.
gameEncounter.quote_game: Every star dies. Every bond breaks. Why pretend otherwise?

legendaryNikes.name: Phoenix Nike
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: Was literally dead at the time (temporarily)
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Exhaustion - tired of endless rebirth
legendaryNikes.corruptionEra: Early Silence (100-200 years after Prime Era)
legendaryNikes.quote: Do you know what it's like to die a thousand times? To wake up AGAIN? I just want to sleep.

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Found in a region alternating between scorching heat and cold ash. Has died and been reborn countless times—each cycle a scream of 'please let me rest.' Erupts into a pillar of fire touching the void itself. Immortality's exhaustion given form. The undying flame that wants nothing more than to finally go out.
gameEncounter.quote_game: Do you know what it's like to die a thousand times and remember every one?

legendaryNikes.name: McJared Nike
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: Probability said he wouldn't help (he calculated wrong)
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Calculation - the math said Nolem would win, so he joined the winning side
legendaryNikes.quote: The odds were 99.7% that Nolem wins. I'm just being rational.

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Reality glitches near his domain—coins land on edges, dice show impossible numbers. A bunny-shaped figure in socks. Attacks with probability itself—making hits miss, defenses fail, luck run out. But luck isn't everything. Hope beyond probability—the conviction that the odds can be beaten not through chance but through will.
gameEncounter.quote_game: The odds of you winning are approximately zero. But that's what makes it FUN.

legendaryNikes.name: Olecram Nike
legendaryNikes.description: Chimera with dragon arm and jelly head
legendaryNikes.primeEraRole: Identity crisis - didn't know which side he was on
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: Couldn't be trusted - too unstable
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Identity loss - Nolem promised to make him whole
legendaryNikes.quote: I don't know what I am. At least with Nolem, I don't have to.

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Exists in the Deep Network as scattered fragments—data corrupted beyond recognition. A figure in pieces across a thousand processes. Each fragment is a different emotion, a different memory, a different identity. The chimera who lost himself. Must find a center to be whole again.
gameEncounter.quote_game: Which piece of me are you looking for? I have so many.

legendaryNikes.name: Melon Nike
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: Unknown
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Willing betrayal - chose to join Nolem
legendaryNikes.campaignBossNote: CORRECTED 2026-07-26. An earlier version of this note claimed Melon's node carries 'no isAnchorBoss and no grantAnchor'. That is FALSE: act2_002_melon_boss.json DOES set isAnchorBoss:true (which is the engine's CATCHABILITY gate, not a region-anchor marker). What it lacks is grantAnchor — he grants no Dimensional Anchor. The six grantAnchor holders are Viking, Nike Tyson, Gladiator, Cyberpunk, Ninja and OG Nike. Melon is NOT one. He is also POST-CAMPAIGN: his chain entry (nolem_maw/act2_001_betrayer_path) requires campaign_complete. OPEN QUESTION for the owner — campaignBoss:true here is doubtful. If the field means 'a boss fight in the main campaign (Act 1)', Melon should be false, since Act 2 is post-campaign endgame. Under that reading the field is correct on 26 of 27 records and Melon is the sole outlier. Do not sweep other records on the strength of this one; see GAME_DELTAS.

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: The only Legendary who willingly and consciously chose Nolem's side without any corruption. Found inside Nolem's Maw, completely uncorrupted, arms crossed, utterly calm. Tracked the Walker's progress since Shinden. Intelligent, casual, genuinely convinced Nolem is right. Argues that three thousand years of fighting has accomplished nothing—Nolem's victory is inevitable, and joining early was a strategic choice. Not evil. Not broken. Just... a realist who chose survival over hope — but that is the surface, and the game shows what is under it. Pressed hard enough he breaks: "I was SCARED, okay?! Is that what you want to hear?! I saw the numbers and I was TERRIFIED and I couldn't... I couldn't face another loss..." The realism is armour over fear. The lone Legendary who sided with Nolem by choice — not a Harbinger (those are fallen Collector humans), but a Nike who embraced his cause and would shepherd others toward it. Unlike every other Legendary, he's not fighting corruption—he's embraced it willingly, and his conviction is his armor.
gameEncounter.gameCharacterization: Casual, intelligent, articulate. No malice. Genuinely believes he made the rational choice. The most unsettling Legendary encounter because he might be RIGHT. Makes the player question whether hope is strategy or delusion.
gameEncounter.corruptionTheme_updated: Willing betrayal — Redemption vs Justice. Is survival pragmatism or cowardice? Is hope strategy or delusion?
gameEncounter.quote_game: 'Betrayer.' Such an ugly word. I prefer 'realist.' Or 'convert.' Or even 'the only one who actually THOUGHT about it.'

legendaryNikes.name: Peter Porker Nike
legendaryNikes.primeEraRole: Protecting his home dimension - refused to leave
legendaryNikes.whyNotRecruited: Said his dimension needed him more
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Exhaustion - carried too much alone for too long
legendaryNikes.quote: With great power comes... exhaustion. So much exhaustion.

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Found in the Arena's rafters, covered in ancient, intricate webs. Swings between them watching with too-many eyes. An exhausted spider-sense hero. His exhaustion turned to desperation—attacks not from malice but from a need to prove he can still protect SOMETHING, even if it's just his loneliness. The weight of responsibility crushing a hero who never learned to share the burden.
gameEncounter.quote_game: I can't stop. If I stop watching, someone gets hurt. Someone ALWAYS gets hurt.

legendaryNikes.name: OG Nike
legendaryNikes.description: The original, the legend, the first Nike
legendaryNikes.primeEraRole: THE TEMPLATE - source of all 5,555 Nikes
legendaryNikes.burden: Feels every Nike across every dimension—their joys, fears, and deaths
legendaryNikes.corruptionReason: Exhaustion - carrying 5,555 souls for eons
legendaryNikes.quote: Nike Prime isn't one soul carrying 5,555. Nike Prime is 5,555 souls carrying each other.
legendaryNikes.specialNote: Final raid boss - represents what happens if the Template falls

gameEncounter.gameNarrative: Encountered at the edge of reality during the Void Terminus campaign. Not a boss fight—a guide. Catches the souls of Nikes killed by Nolem before they can be absorbed. Has done this for three thousand years without rest. Appears multiple times: first as a warning before the Void beasts, then again before the final gate to give his blessing. Explains the full context of the 5,555 prophecy. Much more active than his 'exhausted at the edge of reality' lore description suggests—a pivotal late-game character who bridges the comic era to the present.
activeRole: Warns Walker about Legendary guardians blocking the path
Catches souls of fallen Nikes to prevent Nolem's absorption
Gives blessing before entering Nolem's Maw
First to speak the prophecy: 'Nike Prime isn't one soul carrying 5,555...'
Appears at Void Terminus completion to confirm hope
gameEncounter.quote_game: Three thousand years. Give or take. I catch their souls before he can absorb them. If I stop, even for a moment, he gets stronger.

primeEraChampions.description: The Five Champions gathered by Stoner Nike for Comic Book 1
primeEraChampions.note: Nike Tyson was called 'Boxer Nike' during the Prime Era. The name evolved over millennia.

scholarNikes.description: The minds who built Nike Prime (not Legendary Nikes but important)
scholarNikes.note: These are not Legendary Nikes but played crucial roles in Comic Book 1
